text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The Ward Councillor has requested operating conditions be imposed on the boulevard café permit located at 444 Spadina Avenue.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the application for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 444 Spadina Avenue; and 2. Approved the operating conditions proposed by the Ward Councillor for the proposed boulevard café permit located at 444 Spadina Avenue: a. Municipal Licensing and Standards to review in one (1) year and to report to the Councillor's office on any complaints received. b. Signage will be posted in a prominent location to remind people to be considerate of the surrounding community. c. A telephone number will be provided for neighbours to register concerns or complaints directly with restaurant management. d. There will be no outdoor music or amplified sound on the patio, and doors and windows to the establishment will not be left open or propped open while there is music or amplified sound in the interior.
